run_densepose_training: run the DensePose training script with a config file and optional command-line arguments
setup_densepose_config: setup the DensePose configuration by merging a config file with command-line options and freezing it
build_densepose_model: build a DensePose model from the configuration using Trainer.build_model
resume_densepose_weights: resume or load DensePose model weights using DensePoseCheckpointer with a specified weights path
evaluate_densepose_model: evaluate a trained DensePose model with optional test-time augmentation using Trainer.test
